title: Weighted orthogonality identity
hypotheses_covered: finite index sets α and β
real array φ : α × β → ℝ
columns of φ are orthogonal with common squared length c (∑ₓ φ(x,y)φ(x,z) = c if y=z else 0)
replaced:
Let $\phi : \alpha \to \beta \to \mathbb{R}$ be a family of functions satisfying the
orthogonality condition $\sum_{x:\alpha} \phi(x,y)\,\phi(x,z) = c \cdot [\![y=z]\!]$
for a constant $c$.  Then for any weights $b : \beta \to \mathbb{R}$,
\[
  \sum_{x:\alpha} \Bigl(\sum_{y:\beta} b(y)\,\phi(x,y)\Bigr)^2
  \;=\; \sum_{y:\beta} b(y)^2 \cdot c.
\]
